neighbours.label: An instruction to take a brief physical break: 'get up and do', 'or do some jumping jacks', 'close your eyes and'; other instructions in imperative form stay quiet
fire: Stand up after an hour at your desk and do some stretches.
Walk around the room for a minute or two or do some squats.
Take a second to close your eyes and breathe slowly.
Get off the couch during the ads and do a few push-ups.
Between tasks, stop for a minute and stretch your arms.
Step away from the screen and do something else for a while.
Pause for a moment, close your eyes and relax your shoulders.
Roll your neck for a minute or two or do some shoulder shrugs.
quiet: Stand up after the judge enters and face the bench.
Walk around the town for a day or two with a map.
Take a bus to the station and buy a ticket.
Get off the train at York and change for Leeds.
Between meals, the cook washed the pots and cleaned the floor.
Step away from the edge and hold the rail at all times.
Pay the fee, sign the form and hand it to the clerk.
Paint the fence for a week or two with a brush.

short: instruction to take a brief physical break
notes: Card: ' and' x7, ',' x4, ' do' x2, ' minute' x2, ' some', 先. Probe: 'or do some' 0.71, 'get up and' 0.64, 'close your eyes and' 0.33, 'shake off the jet lag and' 0.15; non-instructions 0.01-0.11.
